scope: Local macOS arm64 pure provider decoder API. This is not live voice publication, current native/provider source custody, task/effect binding, worker action execution or complete G6-043 qualification.
observations: The public decode_agent_event API calls the same existing bounded normalizer as the engine adapter; no copied second Vapi parser or legacy compatibility path was introduced.

Both asserted callId and call.id must match the captured expected route before terminal or action content can be returned. The decoder cannot choose that actual route or grant Connect authority; the host must supply its owned captured reference.

Raw input is bounded to1MiB, and all output items/event references pass the existing64KiB/512-byte metadata validation before returning any prefix. More than32 actions gives an unavailable item rather than a valid action prefix.
Partial, final and unavailable transcript observations, missing fields and provider user role remain distinct. The user role does not identify a human Participant in mixed caller audio.

Documented direct/wrapped tool lists normalize once per frame. Separate repeated frames/IDs remain observations. Model task/effect arguments are retained as untrusted data; reported results remain ResultObserved and do not complete an operation.
Debug output redacts contents and provider references. The API has no network IO, Store source registration, authorization or action dispatch.
generated_source_policy: A new private dependency directory was prepared from pinned sources plus all124 digest-checked patches. The prior prepared tree remains preserved.4025 byte-identical files retain their earlier timestamps for compiler caching; only the two files in the new recorded patch differ. Source content was not edited directly in .deps.
http_scope: Existing session.observations reference; no HTTP route or wire-schema change in this pure decoder component.
remaining_work: Bind actual public/private native provider instances and original audiences to typed observation source capabilities under current authority.

Prevent buffered derived content from outliving revoked original provider memory/source authorization, and close sources on captured provider termination rather than relying only on native Connection state.
Map optional transcript/speech/action capabilities and explicit unavailable/gap/result metadata without inventing a human speaker or requiring unsupported model events.
Preserve trusted task/effect correlation separately from model arguments; expose stable proposed action identity for authorized external workers using public operations.
Prove duplicate tool calls, changed provider IDs, partial transcripts and session-end races never trigger duplicate handoffs in the actual runtime.
not_run: Existing runtime/Store suites were not rerun for this additive pure decoder export; prior G6-042 evidence remains historical for its123-patch source scope.
No live publication/worker proof, Linux/browser/remote/provider rehearsal, independent acceptance or publication.
